# react-text-to-speech

> react-text-to-speech is an easy-to-use React library for converting text to speech using the Web Speech API. It provides the `useSpeech` hook and the `<Speech>` component, with features including real-time text highlighting, dynamic speech controls, directives, unlimited text length, multiple speech instances, error handling, and TypeScript support.

The documentation website is the canonical source for installation, usage guides, API reference, and examples.

## Documentation

- Introduction: https://rtts.vercel.app/docs/
- useSpeech Hook: https://rtts.vercel.app/docs/usage/useSpeech
- Speech Component: https://rtts.vercel.app/docs/usage/speech
- API Reference:
  - https://rtts.vercel.app/docs/api/useSpeech
  - https://rtts.vercel.app/docs/api/speech
- Demo: https://rtts.vercel.app/demo
- FAQ: https://rtts.vercel.app/faqs
